name: July
summary: The peak: every park at maximum crowd, maximum price and maximum heat, with July Saturdays the busiest single days most of these parks see all year.

verdict.short: July at these parks: a peak-crowd month that rewards a specific plan. The peak: every park at maximum crowd, maximum price and maximum heat, with July Saturdays the busiest single days most of these parks see all year..

peakWindows: Every Saturday, and the July Fourth week

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: July Fourth week is the single most crowded week of the year at most parks on this site; any other week is an improvement.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: The evening window — the last two hours — recovers much of the day: the family exodus at dinner is real and the queues follow it.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
